title: Fireport
summary: Fireport is a spell used to teleport short distances in a burst of flames. Upon teleportation, the burning aura remains for a while.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
On the volcanic island containing [[Phoenix]]'s [[Ring]], [[Shauna]] used this spell in the [[Phoenix Volcano]] to escape from [[Sabriel|Powerbonded Sabriel]] whilst captured by the Huntik team. She then used it to evade [[Sophie Casterwill]]'s attacks. The spell later was used so that [[Wind]] could escape with [[Shauna]] from the erupting volcano. {{source|The Phoenix's Ashes}}
